The '''MT-5 hyperdrive''' was a unit created by [[Pitareeze Inc.]] to be installed in their [[Pitareeze Cruiser]]. It was reportedly much faster than any other unit on the market as of [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]]. When one employee of Pitareeze Inc, [[Olag Greck]], stole the designs for the cruiser and created a number of shoddy imitations called [[Greck Cruiser]]s, the hyperdrive unit was only in the prototype stage. The units in Olag's ships proved faulty and Baron [[Pitareeze]] refused his request for help. Years later, Greck took the Baron's grandson, [[Nak Pitareeze]], hostage and claimed he'd tried to steal on of his cruisers. He claimed he would throw Nak on a prison barge if Baron Pitareeze did not bring him the functioning MT-5 unit. In the end, Greck was fooled into accepting a food hydrator under the impression that it was the unit.
